predictionsFrom: production engine (app.js) under explicit interpretation overrides, via scripts/lab-harness.mjs

closeRange.question: EA: automatic weapons have the very close-range maximum damage step "reduced or removed" against armour. Removed is implemented.
closeRange.interpretationA: remove — leading max-damage step dropped, second step applies from 0 m (implemented)
closeRange.interpretationB: keep — leading step retained, +10 m range shift only

spillover.question: Does leftover damage on the armour-breaking shot carry into health? No source states either way.
spillover.interpretationA: none — the breaking shot damages armour only (implemented)
spillover.interpretationB: proportional — the unused fraction of that shot carries into health
